rule: Hand labels for the risks of the W18 brief: a point construction that the text requires (midpoint, foot of a perpendicular) must bind to the text relation by entity identity — operand change, target swap or rename, and same-coordinate entities are MISMATCHED; a correct construction the server cannot read is UNVERIFIED (refused in the polyhedral scope, U3); engine-derived points the text does not name are AUXILIARY. `expect` is the route outcome after the fix: `served`, or `refused:<stage>:<reason_code>:<cause>`. `binding` is the expected status of the key construction. Base text `NEN_P1` (gold p1 coordinates) unless the row says cuboid. Every row has a builder of the same id in backend/tests/geometry/test_construction_binding.py; the corpus builder checks the texts against this file.
